description: We turn NASA data into tools people can trust. We build full data-to-decision systems: NASA/NOAA data pipelines, ML forecasts (Random Forest, LSTM) and AI assistants that explain science in plain language, checked against official sources (RAG + LangGraph). Our goal: put NASA Earth data in the hands of people who need it, like farmers facing heat, drought and floods. Looking for: web/front-end developer, designer/storyteller, climate or agriculture enthusiasts and curious learners.
